title: Solve the learning curve
promptMarkdown: For L=½(ab−2)² under gradient flow with a₀=b₀=0.2, derive the conserved difference a²−b² and solve q=ab. Find q(1) and the time to q=1.8. Explain what happens at exactly zero initial factors and why the differential-equation result does not guarantee convergence of an arbitrary discrete step size.
hintLadder: Differentiate the squared difference before solving either factor.
Solve for the remaining fraction rather than guessing a half-time.
